title.zh: Evercrest (KelpDAO) Files Civil Claim Against LayerZero and CEO Bryan Pellegrino - Coinpedia
title.en: Evercrest (KelpDAO) Files Civil Claim Against LayerZero and CEO Bryan Pellegrino - Coinpedia

current_state.zh: KelpDAO开发商Evercrest已在加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省最高法院对LayerZero Labs Ltd.、LayerZero Labs Canada Inc.及Bryan Pellegrino个人提起民事诉讼，指控过失虚假陈述、过失和诽谤，涉及约2.92亿美元rsETH跨链桥漏洞；LayerZero CEO Pellegrino公开回应称诉讼毫无依据并将在温哥华应诉；目前尚无针对该诉状的正式答辩，案件处于公开争议阶段。
current_state.en: KelpDAO developer Evercrest has filed a civil claim in the Supreme Court of British Columbia against LayerZero Labs Ltd., LayerZero Labs Canada Inc. and Bryan Pellegrino personally, alleging negligent misrepresentation, negligence and defamation over the approximately $292 million rsETH bridge exploit; LayerZero CEO Pellegrino has publicly dismissed the claim as meritless and said he will defend it in Vancouver; no formal response to the claim has been filed yet, leaving the matter in open dispute.

updates.title_zh: KelpDAO Developer Sues LayerZero Over $292M Bridge Exploit
updates.title_en: KelpDAO Developer Sues LayerZero Over $292M Bridge Exploit
updates.what_changed_zh: 新增诉讼细节：Evercrest Technologies在加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省最高法院对LayerZero Labs Ltd.、LayerZero Labs Canada Inc.及Bryan Pellegrino个人提起民事诉讼，指控过失虚假陈述、过失和诽谤；索赔包括2,000 ETH用于恢复rsETH背书、漏洞后逾6.5亿美元提款及KERNEL代币下跌造成的损失；诉状还详述了攻击时间线（3月6日恶意软件植入LayerZero开发者电脑、4月18日节点被篡改）及LayerZero未向Evercrest发出类似USDT0的风险警告；目前尚无对诉状的答辩。
updates.what_changed_en: Added lawsuit specifics: Evercrest Technologies filed a civil claim in the Supreme Court of British Columbia against LayerZero Labs Ltd., LayerZero Labs Canada Inc. and Bryan Pellegrino personally, alleging negligent misrepresentation, negligence and defamation; damages include a 2,000 ETH contribution to restore rsETH backing, over $650 million withdrawn after the exploit and losses from the KERNEL token decline; the claim also details the attack timeline (malware on a LayerZero developer's computer on March 6, node tampering by April 18) and alleges LayerZero failed to give Evercrest a risk warning comparable to one given to USDT0; no response to the claim has yet been filed.

updates.detailed_summary_zh: Evercrest Technologies, the company behind KelpDAO, filed a civil claim in the Supreme Court of British Columbia against LayerZero Labs, LayerZero Labs Canada and co-founder Bryan Pellegrino, alleging negligent misrepresentation, negligence and defamation over the $292 million bridge exploit that drained the restaking protocol in April.
